messages:
maya: quick ping — opened PR #8421 to wire auth-proxy env handling for onprem deploys. mainly: add PROXY_AUTH_MODE + use vault path /secret/redwood/onprem/auth-proxy. needs security & infra signoff before i merge. https://git.company/repo/pull/8421 :eyes:

raj: on it, thanks. will skim now and do a deeper review after lunch. any expected service-account scope changes?

maya: no new scopes intended — reusing existing onprem-sa. main change is how we fetch the proxy token (rotate via vault) instead of embedding. tiny diff, pasted snippet below:

```bash
# server env load
export PROXY_AUTH_MODE=vault
export PROXY_VAULT_PATH=secret/redwood/onprem/auth-proxy
```

sasha: sec-bot ran scan: "secret-scan: no plaintext secrets detected" :white_check_mark: but flagged a TODO comment about fallback behavior.

olivia: quick question — if vault is unreachable, do we fall back to a local file? that could be risky depending on who can access the node. recommend fail-closed.

maya: agree, fail-closed is the plan. currently code does: try vault -> on error exit(1). i can add an explicit comment + unit test.

tim: are there any VPC egress rules changed? onprem envs shouldn't leak to public proxies. if the proxy endpoint is routable outside the VPC we need an allowlist check.

maya: proxy endpoint remains internal to customer VPC by default, but we added a config flag PROXY_EXTERNAL for special cases. i'll add a note in the PR describing default behavior and risk.

raj: i'll prioritize review this afternoon. if nothing blocking i'll approve. would be good to get eng-infra eyes too (cc @tim).

sec-bot: automated-note: please ensure KMS envelope encryption is used for stored tokens and rotation policy exists. See docs: https://internal.docs/security/kms-rotations

maya: thanks — will wire KMS envelope encryption and link the rotation plan in the PR description. aiming for merge EOD Friday unless security finds issues.

olivia: sounds good. if you add the fail-closed test and KMS note i'm fine approving.

raj: leaving a few inline comments on the error handling and logging. nothing blocking.

maya: perfect — i'll address comments and ping again when updated. thanks all :pray:

sasha: noted. once updated, i can run a quick smoke in our staging VPC to confirm no external egress.

maya: great, plan: maya addresses comments + adds KMS note, sasha runs staging smoke, raj + olivia approve, target merge window EOD Friday. if any blocker surfaces we'll push to Monday.

sec-bot: reminder: please request an explicit sec-approval thread when gating production rollouts (for audit).

maya: will create a short sec-approval thread after addressing comments. thanks everyone!
